sides.text: Which NAT type maps many inside hosts to a single public address using ports?
A. PAT (overload)
In NAT, what is the inside global address?
options: The public address representing an inside host
The private address of a host

sides.text: B. The public address representing an inside host

more.text: Inside local is the private address.

sides.text: Which port does NTP use?
C. UDP 123
What does ntp master configure?
options: The router as an authoritative time source at a given stratum

sides.text: D. The router as an authoritative time source at a given stratum

more.text: It serves time from its own clock.

sides.text: Which DHCP message does a client broadcast first?
A. Discover
Which command lets a router forward DHCP broadcasts to a remote server?
B. ip helper-address
Which syslog severity level is 'warnings'?
Which SNMP version adds authentication and encryption?
D. SNMPv3

more.text: v1 and v2c use community strings.

sides.text: An SNMP agent sends an unsolicited alert to the manager. What is it called?
A. A trap
Which DSCP class provides low-latency priority queuing for voice?
B. EF
What is the difference between policing and shaping?
options: Policing drops or remarks excess traffic; shaping buffers it

sides.text: C. Policing drops or remarks excess traffic; shaping buffers it

more.text: Shaping smooths bursts at the cost of delay.

sides.text: Which protocol is used to copy an IOS image without authentication?
D. TFTP

more.text: TFTP uses UDP 69 and no authentication.

sides.text: Which command is required to generate keys for SSH on a router?
A. crypto key generate rsa

more.text: A hostname and domain name are required first.

sides.text: Which DNS record maps a name to an IPv4 address?
B. A
Which transport does DNS use for large responses and zone transfers?
C. TCP 53
Which NAT command identifies the interface facing the private network?
D. ip nat inside

more.text: Each NAT interface is marked inside or outside.

sides.text: What does the command show ip nat translations display?
A. Active NAT translation entries
Which QoS mechanism marks traffic with a value for downstream devices?
B. Classification and marking
In QoS, where should trust be established?
options: At the trust boundary near the edge

sides.text: C. At the trust boundary near the edge

more.text: Devices beyond the boundary honor the markings.

sides.text: What is the purpose of DHCP excluded addresses?
D. Reserve addresses for static devices
